subtitle: Lesson 9 · SOQL Aggregation & Grouping

eyebrow: WHERE filters rows, HAVING filters groups
code:
SELECT Industry, COUNT(Id) accounts
FROM Account
GROUP BY Industry
HAVING COUNT(Id) > 10

-- WHERE: rows go in
-- HAVING: groups survive
caption: Same division of labor as T-SQL.

code:
SELECT StageName,
       COUNT(Id) deals,
       SUM(Amount) pipeline
FROM Opportunity
WHERE CloseDate = THIS_YEAR
GROUP BY StageName
HAVING SUM(Amount) > 1000000
   AND COUNT(Id) >= 3
ORDER BY SUM(Amount) DESC
caption: WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, in that order.

code:
SELECT Email, COUNT(Id) copies
FROM Contact
WHERE Email != null
GROUP BY Email
HAVING COUNT(Id) > 1
ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
caption: Drop the null filter and blanks swamp the result.
